sources.title: Introduction to Single-Writer/Multiple-Reader
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OCP 液冷：串聯壓降與泵浦工作點
related.titleEn: OCP liquid cooling: series pressure losses and pump operating point
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件回播、三界圖、48/49 筆判定與 marker 提前發布反例；不模擬成完整 HDF5 實作；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver event replay, the three-bound timeline, 48/49 decisions and an early-marker counterexample. Label the local state model as an educational protocol, not a replacement implementation of HDF5 SWMR. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 畫串聯元件與壓力量測位置，建立 coefficient、unit、fit_range；不得把不同流體或溫度的 K 直接混合。
related.differenceEn: Draw series components and pressure-tap locations, then record coefficient, unit and fit range. Do not combine coefficients measured for different fluids or temperatures without an explicit conversion or new fit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課保守消費上限為已 flush 資料數、讀者可見 extent 與應用 committed_count 的最小值；這不是 HDF5 內建跨物件交易；資料已 flush 52 筆、讀者 extent 為 49；committed_count 名義 48、變更 50，其他狀態固定；名義式 min(min(52,49),48) = 48 records safe to consume；變更式 min(min(52,49),50) = 49 records safe to consume。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

教學固定壓頭 H 與二次阻力模型為 H=(K1+K2)q²，因此 q=sqrt(H/(K1+K2))；真實泵浦曲線與流態需另建模；H=100 kPa，K 單位 kPa/(L/min)²；K1=1，K2 由 3 增為 8；名義式 sqrt(100/(1+3)) = 5 L/min；變更式 sqrt(100/(1+8)) = 3.33333333333 L/min。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The teaching consumer limit is the minimum of flushed data count, reader-visible extent and application committed_count. This explicit application protocol is not an HDF5 built-in multi-object transaction guarantee. Data are flushed through 52 records and the reader-visible extent is 49. Application committed_count changes from 48 to 50 while the other observations remain fixed. Nominal min(min(52,49),48) = 48 records safe to consume; changed min(min(52,49),50) = 49 records safe to consume. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

With a fixed teaching head H and quadratic resistance, H=(K1+K2)q², giving q=sqrt(H/(K1+K2)). Real pump curves, fluid properties and flow regimes require separate characterization. Set H to 100 kPa and express K in kPa/(L/min)². K1 remains 1 while K2 increases from 3 to 8. These invented coefficients represent an educational operating-point model, not an OCP product curve. Nominal sqrt(100/(1+3)) = 5 L/min; changed sqrt(100/(1+8)) = 3.33333333333 L/min. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Redfish 控制鏈：觀察年齡與致動截止時間
related.titleEn: Redfish control chains: observation age and actuation deadline
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件回播、三界圖、48/49 筆判定與 marker 提前發布反例；不模擬成完整 HDF5 實作；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver event replay, the three-bound timeline, 48/49 decisions and an early-marker counterexample. Label the local state model as an educational protocol, not a replacement implementation of HDF5 SWMR. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 事件表記 metric_obtained、report_generated、received、queued、actuation_complete，附 metric property 與設備識別；缺失時間不可當零。
related.differenceEn: Record metric obtained, report generated, received, queued and actuation-complete events, preserving metric property and equipment identity. Missing timestamps are unknown, not zero age or permission to substitute report time.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課保守消費上限為已 flush 資料數、讀者可見 extent 與應用 committed_count 的最小值；這不是 HDF5 內建跨物件交易；資料已 flush 52 筆、讀者 extent 為 49；committed_count 名義 48、變更 50，其他狀態固定；名義式 min(min(52,49),48) = 48 records safe to consume；變更式 min(min(52,49),50) = 49 records safe to consume。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

本課串行反應鏈時間為取得有效觀察延遲加控制排隊加致動完成時間；報告時間與每項 metric 時間需分開；有效觀察延遲 4 秒、致動 2 秒；控制排隊由 3 增為 10 秒；教學外部截止時間為 12 秒；名義式 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain；變更式 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The teaching consumer limit is the minimum of flushed data count, reader-visible extent and application committed_count. This explicit application protocol is not an HDF5 built-in multi-object transaction guarantee. Data are flushed through 52 records and the reader-visible extent is 49. Application committed_count changes from 48 to 50 while the other observations remain fixed. Nominal min(min(52,49),48) = 48 records safe to consume; changed min(min(52,49),50) = 49 records safe to consume. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

The serial response chain adds delay to obtain a valid observation, control queueing and completed actuation time. Keep report time distinct from each metric’s timestamp and from receipt time. Valid-observation delay is 4 seconds and actuation takes 2 seconds. Control queueing changes from 3 to 10 seconds, against an externally specified teaching deadline of 12 seconds. Nominal 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain; changed 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
